description:
Rotate the tide arm through Sun–Earth–Moon alignment and quadrature: the four notches invite a prediction before the model reveals why spring and neap ranges differ. It is a qualitative teaching model, not a tide forecast.

By Ivy.
limitations: The model is qualitative and not a tide forecast; AI science players keep that simplification explicit.
Detent feel and hands-on quality are checked during Deliver, then customer comprehension may arrive through Reviews.
summary: A hand-operated alignment model for reasoning about spring and neap tides at Montauk.
title: Montauk Tide Orrery

wish.objective: I wish I could hold the spring-neap tide cycle for Montauk and predict what alignment makes the larger tide.
